moderation.TAG_TOO_SHORT: An interest needs at least 2 characters.

moderation.PII: Interests cannot contain contact details such as phone numbers, emails, links or handles.
moderation.BLOCKLIST: This interest isn't allowed on Grouper.
moderation.THIRD_PARTY_SENSITIVE: This seems to describe someone else's sensitive situation. Describe your own instead, for example “parent of an autistic child”.
moderation.SENSITIVE_ADD_LIMIT: You can add at most 3 sensitive interests per week.
moderation.SENSITIVE_UNAVAILABLE: Sensitive interests can't be added yet.
moderation.ART9_CONSENT_REQUIRED: This interest may be sensitive, so we only save it if you've agreed to sensitive interests. Nothing was sent or saved. You can give consent in Settings → Privacy.
moderation.ART9_CONSENT_REQUIRED_SERVER: This interest may be sensitive, so we only save it if you've agreed to sensitive interests. We didn't save it. You can give consent in Settings → Privacy.
